title: Change index and version families
text: Change index and hub-and-spoke families: every release from 1.14.4 to 26.3 diffed against the next in Mojang's names (`coverage/changes/`, `tools/ChangeIndex.java`), 24 families cut where an update breaks 1% or more of the game's names, each with a hub picked by Modrinth mod count, rule coverage and the best ledger run per step, shown in the porting map (`docs/index.html#porting`). Releases before 1.14.4 are listed as blocked (no official mappings).
